recap.text: Donut cries that she has a spell book and opens her Bronze Boss Box, and she glows before Carl can read the description, because she has already applied it. She screams with rage. Mordecai, amused, says she really must examine items before she equips or applies them, then names the spell: Torch, a curl of light that follows her and grows stronger with use. Donut calls it stupid. Carl agrees it is good.

beats.headline: A stupid spell, apparently
beats.text: A spell book, Donut cries, opening her Bronze Boss Box, and she glows before Carl has time to read the description: she has already applied it. Then she cries out with rage. Mordecai, amused, tells the little one she really must examine these items before she equips or applies them. It's a stupid spell, Donut says. It's a very useful spell, says Mordecai, and tells Carl what it is: Torch. It makes a curl of light follow her around, and the more she uses it, the more powerful it gets. Carl agrees it's a good spell.
beats.gist: Donut applies an unread spell from her Bronze Boss Box; Mordecai says Torch is very useful.
